ns2:section.sectionText: This course section is restricted to MS students in NRES, CPSC, and AGED programs and graduate nondegree seeking students. Enrolled students are required to have a working microphone and speakers, or a headset with speakers and a microphone, and a high speed internet connection.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, MS:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
